text: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh says underlying inflation has not meaningfully improved and declines to provide forward guidance or a fixed reaction function. The 2-year Treasury yield rose nearly 8 basis points to 4.31% as September hike pricing reached 55.7%.

meta.note: No specific rate decision or fixed policy trigger was stated.

text: The U.S. and Venezuela announce an agreement giving the U.S. majority control over more than 65B barrels of Venezuelan oil reserves. Trump states the arrangement involves Venezuelan officials and private businesses and carries no U.S. taxpayer cost.

meta.note: Operational terms, private participants, and the precise form of majority control are unspecified.
